_note: Each angle resampled to n_points evenly-spaced steps from shot-start (last pause before the downswing) to impact, per professional clip, then the interquartile band taken at each step across clips of the same shot type. Index 0 = shot start, index n_points-1 = impact. Uses the same shot-start/impact rules as the live app (src/pose/estimator.py, src/pose/shot_curve.py).
